purpose: Verify accepted complaint submission succeeds anytime, records submission timestamp, and assigns a unique identifier across submissions.
expected_result: Both complaints succeed with non-null submission timestamps and distinct unique complaint identifiers.

purpose: Verify complaint submission is refused when mandatory category or description is missing or blank.
action_or_input: Submit complaint with empty category or empty description.
expected_result: Submission is refused and no complaint is persisted.

purpose: Verify attachment validation enforces configured file-type, file-size, and count constraints.
preconditions: Authenticated Complainant and configured attachment settings.
action_or_input: Upload an attachment matching configured rules, and attempt uploading an invalid extension or oversized file.
expected_result: Valid attachment is accepted; invalid extension or oversized file is refused.

purpose: Verify submitted complaints start unassigned (no automatic assignment) and require manual handler assignment and categorization.
preconditions: New complaint is submitted; active Complaint Handler exists.
action_or_input: Check newly submitted complaint before handler action, then manually assign and categorize as Handler.
expected_result: Initial complaint has no automatic handler assignment; after manual setup, assignment and category are recorded.

purpose: Verify complaint priority accepts Low, Medium, and High and rejects any other priority value.
preconditions: Active Complaint Handler and submitted complaint exist.
action_or_input: Set priority to Low, Medium, High, and then attempt an unsupported value like Urgent.
expected_result: Low, Medium, and High succeed and persist; unsupported value is refused.

purpose: Verify CMS enforces valid lifecycle states (Submitted, In Progress, Resolved, Rejected, Closed) and records status and progress history.
action_or_input: Progress complaint through valid lifecycle transitions and attempt an invalid direct transition (e.g., Submitted directly to Closed).
expected_result: Valid transitions record status/progress history; unsupported transition is refused.

purpose: Verify a complaint cannot be resolved without resolution details, and valid resolution triggers complainant notification.
preconditions: Active Complaint Handler and unresolved complaint exist.
action_or_input: Attempt resolution with blank resolution details, then resolve with valid resolution details.
expected_result: Blank resolution details are refused; valid resolution persists details and triggers outcome notification.

purpose: Verify a complaint cannot be rejected without rejection reason, and valid rejection records reason and triggers notification.
preconditions: Active Complaint Handler and unresolved complaint exist.
action_or_input: Attempt rejection with blank rejection reason, then reject with valid rejection reason.
expected_result: Blank rejection reason is refused; valid rejection persists reason and triggers outcome notification.

purpose: Verify closure verification enforces the configured verifier (Complainant vs Supervisor) and records Closed status only after verification.
action_or_input: Attempt closure by the wrong role, then verify closure by the configured verifier.
expected_result: Wrong role is refused; configured verifier transitions complaint to Closed and records closure.

purpose: Verify reopening may be requested only for a Closed complaint by its Complainant, and is refused for non-Closed complaints or other users.
preconditions: One complaint in Submitted/Resolved state and one complaint in Closed state.
action_or_input: Attempt reopening request on non-Closed complaint, and by a non-owner user on Closed complaint.
expected_result: Both invalid reopening attempts are refused.

purpose: Verify only Complaint Supervisor can decide reopening requests, updating status on approval and auditing every decision.
preconditions: Closed complaint with pending reopening request; Handler, Supervisor, and Complainant accounts exist.
action_or_input: Handler attempts to decide reopening (refused); Supervisor approves or denies reopening.
expected_result: Non-Supervisor decision is refused; Supervisor decision is audited and updates status upon approval.

purpose: Verify feedback is permitted only after resolution or closure by the Complainant, and can be reviewed by Handler and Supervisor.
preconditions: One complaint in Submitted state and one in Resolved/Closed state.
action_or_input: Attempt feedback on Submitted complaint (refused), submit feedback on Resolved/Closed complaint, and read as Handler/Supervisor.
expected_result: Early feedback is refused; post-resolution/closure feedback is accepted and visible to Handler and Supervisor.

purpose: Verify unresolved complaints can be manually escalated with tracked escalation status, while Closed/Rejected complaints cannot.
preconditions: One unresolved complaint and one Closed complaint.
action_or_input: Escalate unresolved complaint, and attempt to escalate Closed complaint.
expected_result: Unresolved complaint records escalation status; Closed complaint escalation is refused.

purpose: Verify SLA timelines come from configuration (not hardcoded) and drive idempotent pre-breach reminders and automatic escalation.
preconditions: Configured SLA hours and unresolved complaints past reminder and breach thresholds.
expected_result: Reminder and automatic escalation fire once and are not duplicated on the second run.

purpose: Verify only Handler and Supervisor can publish announcements and configured announcement notifications are triggered.
preconditions: Complainant, Handler, and Supervisor accounts exist.
action_or_input: Complainant attempts to publish announcement (refused); Handler publishes announcement.
expected_result: Complainant is refused; Handler succeeds and triggers announcement notification.

purpose: Verify report/summary/analytics role gating and notification-trigger-only boundary.
preconditions: Complainant, Handler, Supervisor, and System Admin accounts exist.
action_or_input: Query reports/summaries across roles and verify notification records remain internal trigger events.
expected_result: Unauthorized roles are refused; authorized roles see only allowed CMS scope; notification triggers are recorded cleanly.

purpose: Verify System Admin time-bounded role assignment/reassignment enforces single active holder per role and rejects non-CMS roles.
preconditions: System Admin and multiple institutional users exist.
action_or_input: Assign Handler role to User A, reassign to User B, and attempt invalid role code.
expected_result: User B becomes the sole active Handler, User A is deactivated, and invalid role codes are refused.

purpose: Verify CMS enforces cross-module boundaries (no cross-module foreign keys or external HR/payroll/maintenance execution).
preconditions: CMS models and API routes are loaded.
action_or_input: Inspect CMS model relations and exposed endpoints.
expected_result: Zero foreign keys to external domain tables and zero excluded external service execution endpoints.
